candidates.text: WERC7575Vault.withdraw() must verify that msg.sender is the owner or has allowance for the shares before withdrawing on behalf of the owner.
evidence_ids: The `withdraw()` function in `WERC7575Vault` fails to verify that `msg.sender` is authorized to withdraw on behalf of the `owner`, allowing anyone to steal funds from users who have self-allowance.

The `WERC7575Vault.withdraw()` function does not implement the authorization check described in its comment. While the comment states "msg.sender must be owner OR have allowance for the shares", the function only calls `_shareToken.spendSelfAllowance(owner, shares)` which checks the owner's self-allowance, not the caller's authorization.
